scope: Primary repositories and publisher documentation; not an exhaustive inventory of all Python packages

items.name: google-ads
items.purpose: Official SDK and current compiler/executor integration
items.caveat: Keep the explicit v25 pin while closing Search; v26 documentation requires Python SDK >=34 but PyPI returned 33.0.0 at retrieval

items.name: google-genai
items.purpose: Gemini structured proposals and controlled tool use
items.caveat: Not installed in the backend interpreter; existing HTTP transport is not automatically defective; no installation or paid inference performed

items.name: pydantic
items.purpose: Existing typed request and response contracts
items.caveat: Structure validation does not prove recommendation quality, factual accuracy or financial authority

items.name: hypothesis
items.purpose: State-machine invariants for retry, idempotency, drift and reconciliation
items.caveat: Use selected meaningful sequences, not large tests mirroring implementation; review license before copying code

items.name: schemathesis
items.purpose: OpenAPI robustness of the existing local backend
items.caveat: Run against isolated services with external writes disabled, never fuzz production mutation routes

items.name: respx
items.purpose: HTTPX failure and provider-contract tests
items.caveat: Not a substitute for Google Ads gRPC/protobuf or real validation tests

items.name: google-ads-api-developer-assistant
items.purpose: GAQL validation, object inspection, conversions diagnostics and version checks
items.caveat: Development assistant, not an arbitrage execution engine

items.name: google-ads-mcp
items.purpose: Read-only account analysis for an assistant
items.caveat: Official current guide states it cannot create assets, change bids or pause campaigns

items.name: google-ads-api-report-fetcher
items.purpose: GAQL-like reports and exporters
items.caveat: Preserve the VOLC collector, lineage and scheduling authority; compatibility must be checked before introducing garf dependencies

items.name: google-adk
items.purpose: Tool-trajectory and result evaluation if needed
items.caveat: Existing development harness declares ADK; do not confuse CLI orchestration with the campaign production runtime

items.name: google-skills
items.purpose: Task instructions for development agents
items.caveat: Instructions are not installed product capabilities

items.name: opentelemetry-python
items.purpose: Trace the existing intent-to-readback flow
items.caveat: Start with current receipts and timings before deploying another monitoring platform

items.name: ads-monitor
items.purpose: Collector metrics and alert design
items.caveat: Not an officially supported Google product; installing Prometheus/Grafana is not required to close Search

items.name: arba
items.purpose: Impression share and Quality Score diagnosis
items.caveat: Diagnostic evidence, not permission to increase bids or guaranteed performance improvement

items.name: negative_keyword_cleaner
items.purpose: Find existing negatives that may block relevant traffic
items.caveat: Do not confuse with generating generic new negative lists; source-term evidence remains necessary

items.name: copycat
items.purpose: Search copy aligned to observed brand/ad examples
items.caveat: No measured improvement over VOLC yet; do not replace the existing cascade without comparison

items.name: adios
items.purpose: Images, library, association and experiments
items.caveat: Use to close the approved-Google-media gap rather than deploy another creative studio

items.name: if-this-then-ad
items.purpose: Event-conditioned action patterns
items.caveat: TypeScript/Apps Script project; its execution and scheduling cannot bypass VOLC

items.name: topic-mine
items.purpose: Trends and first-party data as topic/copy inputs
items.caveat: Do not create a second Attention/Pautador engine

items.name: meridian
items.purpose: Aggregate marketing mix modelling
items.caveat: Not a creation or intraday campaign management harness

items.name: feedx
items.purpose: Shopping feed experiments
items.caveat: Not a general Search campaign launch harness

items.name: facebook-business
items.purpose: Official Meta Marketing API SDK
items.caveat: Existing Meta executor uses HTTP; absence of this package is not proof of an integration defect
